description: C-47B-11-DK c/n 26343 (USAAF 43-49082) that flew with VASP in Brazil and Sadelca in Colombia, last flight to Palmaseca 1998; the museum's centrepiece, painted in KLM colours with the false marking PH-RBA. Berlin Airlift participation claimed by the museum.
Second Dakota listed in the museum inventory (aviationmuseum.eu list); history not established.

Colombia's first 727 (c/n 19127), delivered to Avianca March 1966, later Aerosucre freighter; donated to the museum in April 2015 after 75,000 hours. Parked on the airport side of the museum fence with restricted access and deteriorating; photographed March 2024.

Ex-HK-1274, hijacked between Medellín and Cali in 1973; stored at Cali since 2011 and now carried in JetPhotos as an Aero Fénix aircraft (photographed May 2024). Stands on the apron beside the museum.
Second C-118A, stored at Cali with HK-1703 since 2011 and listed in the museum inventory; condition and exact position need checking.
Ex-FAC Texan that passed to civil use; the museum describes it as the only airworthy AT-6 in Colombia. Registered HK-2049P.
aliases: SNJ-5; AT-6; AT6; T-6; SNJ5; Harvard; HK-2049P; HK2049; T6; HK2049P

description: Ex-FAC A-37B from the 1980 batch (FAC 2156-2175), on loan/donation to the museum; listed in the museum inventory.
aliases: A-37B; A37B; OA-37B; FAC2173; OA37B; A37

description: Ex-FAC Huey from the 1969 batch numbered from FAC 280; visitors may climb inside.

description: Second Beech 18 (18S) listed as HK-1197-P in the museum inventory.
Rare Air & Space 18A autogyro, still on the US register number N6132S.

Amphibian listed in the museum's collection (volavi); registration not established.
